visual_logic.composition: A centered 1:1 shot of **dino_bones_paleontologist_1** kneeling in the tan-grey earth. She is using a fine wooden brush to sweep away dust from a large, fossilized tooth emerging from the ground. The tooth clearly displays the **v-shaped bifid (split) root** unique to Triceratops.
visual_logic.character_details: She is a younger female with **long blonde hair** and **tanned skin**. She is wearing her **white sun hat**, a **light pink blouse** under a **khaki safari vest**, **white shorts**, and **pink hiking boots**.
visual_logic.environment_details: Set in the Lance Hell Creek formation with a ground palette of tan-grey and brownish-black mudstone. In the background, lush canopy elements like palms and tree ferns are visible under a bright midday sun.
visual_logic.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded, toy-like proportions; her expression is one of joyful discovery with a signature friendly smirk.
